case: MySQL/MariaDB DATETIME and TIMESTAMP fractional precision rounding and truncation matrix
contract: Each case inserts 2024-01-02 03:04:05.789956 into DATETIME(0) through DATETIME(6) and TIMESTAMP(0) through TIMESTAMP(6), using both bound parameters and generated SQL literals.
MySQL default SQL mode rounds at each declared precision; TIME_TRUNCATE_FRACTIONAL truncates.
MariaDB default SQL mode truncates at each declared precision; TIME_ROUND_FRACTIONAL rounds.
Each stored value is checked as a native Value, CAST(value AS CHAR), and MICROSECOND(value); TIMESTAMP cases also assert UNIX_TIMESTAMP epoch microseconds with the session timezone set to UTC.

focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration datetime_and_timestamp_fractional_precision_matrix -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

mysql_mariadb_value_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration value_contracts:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1
